raw_text: A viral image showing Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping in an elaborate handshake at the G20 summit in New Delhi has been identified as AI-generated. The image, which spread rapidly through WhatsApp groups and social media platforms, shows the two leaders in a setting that does not match any official G20 venue photographs. While Modi and Xi did have a brief bilateral meeting on the sidelines of the summit, official photographs released by the PMO and Xinhua show a markedly different scene. Digital forensics experts have pointed out anomalies in hand geometry and lighting inconsistencies that are hallmarks of AI image generation tools.
